nodes.label: ADR-013: Contract-Governed External PostgreSQL Chat
nodes.rationale: Introduces a separate tenant-bound external-query capability validating a versioned canonical JSON schema contract and join graph, with a live schema fingerprint checked before every query and blocking on drift, executed as one AST-validated parameterized SELECT under a Vault-held least-privilege read-only role with a row cap and 10s timeout — chosen over (per Alternatives Considered) copying business rows into platform storage (violates no-copy requirement), using vector similarity to authorize schema (not deterministic authorization), reusing the platform SQL whitelist unchanged (doesn't represent customer schema/credentials), or permitting unrestricted read-only SQL (can still expose unauthorized data or exhaust resources). The LLM never holds database credentials and result rows are never persisted.
